SPRING 2026 LIST UPDATE - LIMITED TIME SALE!

This is a limited-time sale for Spring 2026 open from today, 3/20 through Friday 4/10. This is my most extensive list ever, with many first-time releases. There just isn't room in the collection for average plants, and I stand behind every clone on this list being exceptional or noteworthy. I divided a TON of things this winter, so have at it! 

Quantities are limited, so please email me at calen.hall@gmail.com for order confirmation before sending payment. Please do not order via Forum PM, Facebook Messenger, Instagram DM, etc. as I do not check those as often - thank you! Payment via PayPal to calen.hall@gmail.com only at this time. Please pay "Friends and Family" or include an additional 4% to cover PayPal's fee. Shipment bare-root via Priority Mail is typically $15-25, quoted order-by-order. I try not to charge too much for shipping.  USA only. 

Do not hesitate to email me with any questions you may have!

Note: We are having an exceptionally early spring here in Oregon, and plants are waking up rapidly. I like to ship before plants have substantial fragile new growth that can be damaged in shipping, so I reserve the right to end the sale early and / or after a certain date ship only with the understanding that damage may occur. Follow-up to the above: Due to record warmth and active growth I have shortened the sale window to end on 4/10 so I can complete packing and shipment no later than the weekend of Saturday 4/11.



Untitled by Calen Hall, on Flickr

Size Guide
Small - should reach flowering size in the 2027 season and bloom in 2028
Medium - should reach flowering size during the 2026 season
Large - at least one flowering size growth point
XL - more than 4 flowering size growth points 



Flavas

S. flava var. “specklecorpora” Best Clone, Miramar Beach, Walton Co. FL. Extraordinary and unique genetics! Tubes are solid, bright red, but lid remains yellow and is covered in small to medium red dots. Developing traps resemble lit candles with their red bodies and bright yellow lids. Good vigor. One of the most spectacular flavas in the collection, exceedingly rare genetics. small $150

S. flava var. “specklecorpora” Clone 2, Miramar Beach, Walton Co. FL. Not one but two dotticorporas on the list! Sibling to the above, and honestly is spottier! More dots on the upper tube and posterior column where Best Clone has more red infill. Amazing contrast, another standout each year. Can’t wait to see where folks can go breeding these genetics. large $250, medium $200

S. flava var. ornata Select Clone #1, Miramar Beach, Walton Co. FL. One of the best location ornata in cultivation, period. From the now extinct MB ornata bog. Spectacular, intricate venation and a red mouth. It would be hard to choose just one ornata to grow, but this wouldn’t be a poor choice. Rarely available. Good vigor. large $100, med $75

S. flava var. cuprea North Carolina MK F90 - large, shapely traps with lovely burnt sugar tops. A solid and rarely offered Mike King selection. large $50

S. flava var. rubricorpora “Rare true red tube” Sandy Creek, Bay Co. FL A lovely example of a rare true rubricorpora from the Sandy Creek bogs - solid red exterior, yellow and red lid (not an ornata that infuses). large $65

S. flava var atropurpurea Sandy Creek, Bay Co. FL - Even rarer than the above! This clone reliably produces solid red, dark traps under natural light within a couple weeks of opening. A chance selection from a large seed grow-out and the only atro that I am aware of from these populations. large $85

S. flava var atropurpurea (Big Cuprea x Phil’s Blackwater Atro) Best Clone - tall and solid red with big unruly lids. Selected from many, many seedlings. Vigorous and show-stopping. large $60

S. flava var. rubricorpora Solid Dark Red Traps 2015, Liberty Co. FL. The darkest and most completely infused individual from a large seed grow out I did 10 years ago. First public release. It’s an atro but it comes from rubri genetics so that’s what I’m going with. Slighty shorter, to 24”, but overall vigor is good. large $70


S. flava var. ornata (Improved Black Veins x MK F88) Best Clone - very large, incredibly ornately veined traps. Veins under the lid can become so dense it almost turns solid purple. Resembles a 30”+ Black Veins clone! large $75, med $50

S. flava var. rubricorpora Solid Red Throat, Liberty Co. FL - a typical rubricorpora except that the mouth rapidly fills in with a pleasing bright red. Unusual and beautiful. large $45

S. flava “var. cuprea” (Bronze x cuprea) Select, J. Harris. Outcross of Florida and Carolina coppertops with a fantastic result. Tall, shapely, very red/bronzy lids. Not quite an atro but much redder than standard cuprea. large $60 2 plants available

S. flava var atropurpurea (MK F27 x Powhatan) Darkest Clone. This is a killer atro from my own breeding. Dark, big lids and doesn’t tend to brown out as the season progresses. Vigorous. Large $60

S. flava var. ornata (Killer x MK F88) Best Clone - Hard to categorize this one! Large and brooding with a red mouth and various degrees of infusion elsewhere. Draws attention from visitors displaying the best of both parents. large $65

S. flava var. rubricorpora (Phil’s Red Tube x MK F149) Select Clone #2. My own selection from the outstanding Liberty x Bay Co. rubri outcross done by Steve Galic. Tall, almost entirely red traps with just a touch of yellow in the lid. An outstanding red tube. large $75

S. flava var. ornata “Thick Traps” Santa Rosa Co. FL Unique, boxy traps with a thick neck and wide lid. Reddish mouth and moderate venation. A weird western Florida flava! large $45

S. flava var atropurpurea Okaloosa Co. FL - rare offering of selected, seed-grown reds that have been in the collection a long time. Very limited - these clones grow well but are slow dividers. large $125

S. flava var. “bronzy” Ultra Lid, Okaloosa Co. FL. Atro-ornata intergrade with a ridiculous, ridiculous lid. Not difficult to imagine a rose parent a few generations back. Lovely example of how weird flava gets out in western FL. large $65, med $50

S. flava var. rubricorpora Liberty Co 2015 - mixed select dark clones. Divisions from my “keeper” clones, all lovely. large $50, med $35

S. flava var. ornata “Black Veins” Clone B, Bulloch Co. GA. My favorite of the original BV clones that I grow. 12-14” traps are starkly pinstriped with an extremely wide mouth for the pitcher height. Narrow unblotched neck leads to a wide and intensely veined lid. A classic that you should grow if you don’t already! Moderate growth rate - not agonizing like some other original BV clones and will make a nice specimen over time. large $50

S. flava var. ornata “Extreme Black Veins” (Improved Black Veins x Black Veins Clone B) - select clone from a large grow-out. Makes the incredible Clone B look unadorned by comparison. Very, very strong venation on shapely, dwarf traps. Makes my day every time I look at it during summer. large $90

S. flava var. ornata “Black Veins” Damon’s Clone , Bulloch Co. GA. The strongest-growing original BV clone I know of. Lovely veins cover the wide-mouthed, short, blotched traps. Makes specimens readily. large $40

S. flava var. ornata Phil’s Clone - parent of Saurus and many of Phil’s other incredible creations. A mid-range ornata color-wise, but great structure and genetics - a must for breeders. 1 plant available, large $60

S. flava “Goldie” - Unique and stunning, bright, true lemon yellow traps. Amazing for color potential in breeding. SOLD OUT

S. flava var. ornata “Outlaw” Bay Co FL - From a relict, threatened population in western Bay Co. Semi-dwarf, shapely, pinstriped, red-lipped, blotched traps to 18”. Still one of my favorite clones after many, many years. large $50, med $40

S. flava var. atropurpurea (cuprea BH x rubricorpora UCD) Ruffly Lid - acquired this plant as a seedling from CCs in 2013 or so, and it’s still one of my favorite flavas. Large, solid red pitchers with a delightful wave to the lid margin. Divided up my big specimen mother plant after years of letting her grow out. large $50

S. flava var. rubricorpora Phil’s Clone, aka PRT - the stud clone behind many of Phil’s famous crosses and a standout in its own right. Large-lidded traps to well over 30”, solid dark red except for a bit of yellow in the lid. A brooding shadow of a plant. Good vigor and a surprisingly good divider for a giant red tube. large $90, med $70

S. flava var. ornata Lidless, W. Buckner - 6-8” dwarf, heavily veined traps. Solid growth rate and a good flower producer. Large $40

S. flava var. cuprea (Chocolate Top x MW Best) Red Mouth, Extra Dark - Vigorous and shapely, looks like a mass of snakes when it’s pitchers open in spring. My selection from a Jerry A. cross. Strong copper lids deepening to chocolate, with a rare red mouth / lip. This plant turns solid red in bright greenhouse conditions. Large $45

S. flava var. cuprea (MW Best x Lois) “Atrocuprea” - one of the brightest and reddest cupreas ever made, and can turn atro in optimal conditions. Very large, colorful, and vigorous.
Large $45

S. flava Big Mouth- Karen Oudean selection, always gets a lot of attention! “What is THAT?” Etc. Huge yellow pitchers with a thick lip and veins in the mouth. - SOLD OUT

S. flava var. atropurpurea (cuprea Best Clone x Waccamaw) Best of Batch - One of the best atropurpureas in the collection! Blood red with a gorgeous contrasting yellow mouth, gradually infusing fully. 30” pitchers. large $70

S. flava var. atropurpurea (cuprea Best Clone x Waccamaw) Clone #20 Virtually as good as Best of Batch in color, slightly smaller traps - large $45

S. flava var. atropurpurea Cooks Bayou Red, Bay Co. FL - rare western Bay Co atro genetics. Solid red traps, but the real treat is the peachy-orange flowers that likely reflect introgression with rosea. large $45

S. flava var. Extreme Red Throat, Bay Co. FL - Tall, strong growing clones with excellent blotches - mixed select clones - large $60

S. flava var. atropurpurea Waccamaw - The real deal. I have big, big plants available here. XL $250

S. flava var. ornata Blackwater SF, Okaloosa Co. FL - Very select ornata genetics, with some red lids / bronzy clones mixed in to boot. Mixed select clones - large $50

S. flava var. atropurpurea Blackwater SF “Phil’s Blackwater Atro” aka “PBA” one of the best true atros in cultivation, colors easily and a beautiful shape - large $125

S. flava var. rubricorpora Wewahitchka MK F149 one of the darkest rubricorporas around, period. Strong grower too, great for breeding - SOLD OUT

S. flava var. ornata Apalachicola NF MK F88 - Robust red-mouthed traps with excellent venation. Great for breeding - one of my very favorite ornatas - large $60

S. flava var. atropurpurea “Hat Trick” (Big Cuprea x Phil’s Redtube) - My own selection, first time public release. Tall, solid red pitchers with ridiculously large, flamboyant lids! Makes a statement. One of the coolest flavas in the entire collection. medium $75

S. flava var. maxima Okaloosa Co. FL Select Clone #2. Extremely rare genetics, choice seedling selected from many. Shapely, solid glowing green pitchers.- med $35

S. flava var. maxima Okaloosa Co. FL Most Vigorous Clone. Extremely rare genetics, choice seedling selected from many. Shapely, solid glowing green pitchers.- large $50, med $35


S. flava var. rubricorpora “Burgundy” MK F26. Adrian Slack’s ancestral red tube clone still holds it’s own. Shapely, solid red exterior, and a cute blotch - large $70, med $50

S. flava var. rugelii “Bud’s Gargoyle” Walton Co. FL - Collected with permission on Bud Wilkerson’s hunting property. Ridiculously robust, huge mouth and lid. Truly a beast of a plant, hence the name. One of the best rugelii in cultivation - med-sm $75

S. flava var. rubricorpora Purple Tube, Milton FL MK F45 - a very nice, dark rubricorpora from the western range where the color form is uncommon - med-lg $50 1 plant available

S. flava var. atropurpurea (ornata Gulf Coast x cuprea Lois) Best Clone - A stunner! 30-34” solid red pitchers, strong grower, one of my favorite flavas. large $100

S. flava var. cuprea Veinless, South Santee, SC - incredible clone, reminds me of a chanterelle mushroom, one of my favorite flavas every year, shapely yellow overlain with inverse-veined orange-copper - large $100



Leucophyllas

S. leucophylla Yellow Flower, Citronelle, AL MK L69 - Cute green and white traps with typical leuco shape - not a lot of alata obvious in this one. large $40

S. leucophylla var. alba (MK L42 x HCW F) Rod’s Fave Sibling - very white traps to over 30” when happy and also develops a pink mouth with age. large $75

S. leucophylla (Eastern AL x alba Solid White) Select Clone - best seedling from a cross I did a while back. Not quite an alba, but an extremely white clone, particularly in the mouth. Vigorous and produces fall traps early and reliably. large $45

S. leucophylla “Puffy Cheeks” Baldwin Co. AL - an outstanding “normal” leuco - reliably produces tall, big-mouthed pitchers with very pretty thin red veins. Makes a statement each fall. large $60

S. leucophylla “Super Pink” Baldwin Co. AL - lovely pink selection from Mr. Wang. Produces large traps that infuse dark pink in the tube and mouth and stay whiter in the lid, creating a lovely contrast. large $75, 2 plants available

S. leucophylla var. alba “Vigorous Spring White” Washington Co. AL - tall, very white traps, yellow flowers, good vigor. large $50

S. leucophylla “Big White” Okaloosa Co. FL - One of my favorite plants! Not an alba but reliably makes a hedge of very white, stocky, voluminous, large-mouthed traps. Great for breeding and a particularly nice version of leuco for Okaloosa Co. large $80

S. leucophylla Tupelo Tree Bog, Baldwin Co. AL - mixed select clones from a beautiful southern Baldwin Co. population. large $45

S. leucophylla Yellow Flower, Citronelle, AL MK L2 - Just a stunner! Unique shape with a flared mouth, skinny neck, and ostentatious lid. Vigorous and very reliable trap producer. Word to the wise: also seems to contain recessive alba genes and can breed really nice whites! Rare in the US.- large, $40

S. leucophylla Purple Lips x self, Clone 1 - One of the best leucos in cultivation. Better grower than PL. Must have for breeding. Very rare. - med $75

S. leucophylla “Bicolor” Yellow River, FL- absolutely unique, highly sought-after clone. Pitchers rapidly develop a dark pink mouth and light pink tube. Stunning. - med-lg $150, medium $125

S. leucophylla Citronelle, AL MK L53 Underrated clone alert! Tall, alata-introgressed plant from the Citronelle areolata swarm. Amazing color quality - bright white + red suffusing to pink, interesting venation pattern. Excellent breeder. - large $50

S. leucophylla “Wilkerson’s Red Rocket” Walton Co. FL. Another of the absolute best in cultivation. A must-have for serious growers! medium, small $60, medium $100

S. leucophylla “Aurora” Washington Co. AL (L53 x alba Solid White) - gorgeous, delicately veined, shapely very white traps develop beautiful contrasting pink mouths - large $65

S. leucophylla “Red/Pink Mouth” Washington Co. AL (L53 x alba Solid White) - sibling to Aurora with a bit larger traps and deeply contrasting pink mouth. Beautiful and unique. large $50

S. leucophylla Fuzzy Pink Spout Mouth Baldwin Co, AL - Tall, slender tubes with an exaggerated, spouted lip, all infusing deep reddish pink inside and out. One of my favorite pinks. - medium $50, lg $65

S. leucophylla Earliest Pitchering Clone, Baldwin Co. AL - Pitchers in mid to late August for me and is always the first clone in the collection to make fall traps. A vigorous, “typical” leuco but excellent for breeding earlier-pitchering fall whites - large $40

S. leucophylla Pink PPP #5, Gorgeous Traps, Baldwin Co, AL this one drops my jaw every season! Slender tubes with a spacious mouth open heavily veined then infuse deep pink. Consistent, early trap producer - medium $50, large $65

S. leucophylla Stocky, Early Pitchering Red & White, Bud Wilkerson Bog, Walton Co. FL - very robust traps, and produces great pitchers early and reliably even in short season climates! Collected with permission from Bud’s pasture - large $50

S. leucophylla var. alba “Rod’s Favorite” Tall, blinding traps. An outstanding alba year after year. Great breeder - medium $75, large $100

S. leucophylla var. alba (L53 x Solid White) Best Alba Clone - tall, shapely, blinding white traps, vigorous. One of my best alba selections over the years, available again for the first time in a while! large $100

S. leucophylla Stocky Red & White, Bud Wilkerson Bog, Walton Co. FL - a charming clone with good vigor that dependably puts up a nice hedge of colorful traps each fall. Collected with permission from Bud's Bog years ago. large $50

S. leucophylla Yellow River, Santa Rosa Co FL. MK L33 - a very interesting clone with white that stretches abnormally far down the tube. From the now largely destroyed Yellow River site, I suspect some distant rubra gulfensis introgression here. Unique and one of my favorites. Great breeding potential. large $50


Alatas

S. alata “Super Alata” - Jerry Addington selection, possibly the largest dark alata in cultivation HUGE, very dark pitchers. Quite shocking how big this guy can get. Very rare. large $150, med, $125

S. alata Red Cobra - Another ridiculous Jerry alata! 30” + bulbous, hooded traps, just incredible. Unique brighter red trap color, as opposed to “black”. Undoubtedly one of the best alata in cultivation - large $175, med $150

S. alata “Black Throat” - A beautiful, shapely, very dark alit I acquired from Phil years ago. This is one parent of Black Widow, if memory serves. large $50

S. alata (“Night” x self) A great example of how selfing good clones can create even better clones. Larger and darker than Night, very robust and vigorous, reliably producing large traps in late summer and fall. large $60


Hybrids

S. Legacy - Well-deserving of its reputation - large white traps spring and fall, incredible presence - large $250

S. x moorei “Elvis Wilkerson” Walton Co. FL - Very large growing complex moorei from Leah’s front yard. Large $125

S. x areolata Whitest Clone, Jackson Co. MS selected from a large seedling batch, this clone looks just like a robust, bulbous alata shape-wise but with a white-infused upper tube and lid, and a few veins in the mouth. Super cool, introgressed clone, great for areolata breeding projects and should bring good white genes to the table in general! - large $65


S. ‘Black Widow’ Vigorous, huge, dark traps, a favorite of mine year after year - large $50

S. x moorei ‘Catrin Claire’ - Electric candy apple red mouth beneath a large, frilly red and white lid. Stunning clone, great breeder. large 1 GP $300, large 2 GPs $400

S. x moorei ‘Saxapahaw’- large, exceptionally shapely red traps. Gorgeous and rarely offered.- large $150

S. ‘The Kraken’ large $200, med $125

S. x moorei Wilkerson’s White Knight, Walton Co. FL - Beautiful, large white topped traps with an incredible blotch - XL $250, med large $100

S. x moorei (leuco alba Solid White x ornata Improved Black Veins) Best Clone - medium height with very dark inky veins and a contrasting creamy top. Vigorous. large $45

S. x moorei (flava Killer x Super Leuco #1) - Very tall, shapely red traps. Large $45, med $30

S. (Reptilian Rose x Leah Wilkerson) Tall & Crazy - 36” red traps with a weird, distorted mouth and whitish lid. Some might think this plant is ugly, but I’ve certainly kept it around! Large $50

S. (Reptilian Rose x Legacy) Select Clone - bright pinkish red coloration with a throat blotch underneath. Nicely Spouted mouth and a large, attractive peaked lid - large $50

S. (Reptilian Rose x Caitrin Claire) Select Clone - large pink traps with big, unruly lids! large $60, med $45

S. (Vintner’s Treasure x oreophila) x leuco alba Rod’s Favorite - Select Contrast - One of my best selections from the last several years. Attractive traps to 36”, hot pink to purple trap bodies and a pure white lid with stark purple veins. Reliably makes both strong spring and fall traps outdoors in Oregon! large $150

S. (Vintner’s Treasure x oreophila) x leuco alba Rod’s Favorite - Best Clone, Solid White. My goal with this cross was to create plants that make strong white traps in spring, and this clone delivers. Tall, shapely, solid white spring traps outdoors in Cold Oregon. A “leuco alba” you can enjoy in the early season! SOLD OUT

S. x moorei (Prince of Darkness x Super Leuco #1) - Mega Dark & Tall. Enormous and very dark traps - this one pushed 40” last season for me. SOLD OUT

S. (Crown of Thorns x Caitrin Claire) “Lady Rose” - Best seedling from the cross, absolutely best of both parents. Tall white traps, yawning pink mouth and white lid shot through with purple veins. The color quality is unreal on this one. SOLD OUT

S. (Crown of Thorns x Caitrin Claire) - “Rose Witch” - this clone is all of CC’s colors mapped onto CoT's shape - stunning. Candy apple red, scalloped and toothy mouth, red and white lid + tube. SOLID OUT

S. (Leah Wilkerson x Caitrin Claire) Best Clone - Robust traps to over 30”, ghostly white upper tube and lid with a beautiful, faded watercolor-like throat blotch. Large $150, one plant available

S. x moorei ‘Vicious Valentine’ - big, delicately veined shapely traps with creamy, peaked, oversize lids and an unruly red-lipped mouth. A lovely selection - large $125

S. x moorei ‘Vintner’s Treasure’ - One of Phil’s crown jewels, and one of the best red moorei ever made. Exceptionally large, red-purple, beautifully shaped traps. Rarely offered. Large, 3 growth points $500, large, 1 growth point $300.

S. (Reptilian Rose x Adrian Slack) “The Beast” - 4” wide rippled red mouths under an orangey, veined lid. Produces shockingly large, volcanic traps. Likely the most robust and imposing Sarracenia I have personally bred. med-large $300, med $250

S. (Reptilian Rose x Adrian Slack) - Kinky Pink Lip, White Lid - sibling to the above. Vigorous clone producing hedges of 30-33” traps - med $75, large $100

S. (leuco alba Solid White x Grendel) Best Clone - Tall, open-mouthed white-topped traps. Vigorous and makes excellent pitchers in both spring and fall. Large $50

S. x catesbaei “Bengal Tiger” - it’s been too long since I’ve offered this beautiful cat! Intensely veined, blotched traps to around 12” with wide cobra-esque lids. If you only grew one catesbaei, this would be an excellent choice. medium $30, large $45

S. ‘Elaine’s Ice & Fire’ - One of Jerry A’s best creations. Dark purple red tubes with a stunningly contrasting white lid. Traps to around 22-24” - exceedingly rare. Large $500, 2 plants available.

S. ‘Ellie Wang’ - A standout from the legendary Mike W - shapely traps to 24” exhibit solid dark pink-red bodies and contrasting white lids. Lovely and rare. medium $200, large $300

S. x ‘Emma’ - one of THE most beautiful and unique Sarracenias ever created - great work Danny P! 30” traps with manta ray-like red, pink and white, veined lids. The color quality and contrast is unmatched. One of my favorite plants. Best traps in fall. SOLD OUT

S. x mitchelliana “D-P” - Likely the best mitch ever made (a Phil creation, of course!). Parent of Mega Mouth, D-P produces wide, beefy, cartoonishly robust pink and white traps to about 18” - SOLD OUT

S. “Mitch’s Sexy Leg” Parentage is (mitchelliana D-P x Saxapahaw) x Legacy - I got tired of saying that, hence the clone name . Deep red-pink trap bodies under wide, wavy, red / white / pink lids that hold their contrast beautifully. Traps to 30”, best in fall. Fantastic breeder. large $200

S. (Vintner’s Treasure x oreophila) x leuco Big White, Okaloosa Co. FL - Best Clone - another awesome selection from my spring white breeding efforts. Looks for all the world like a robust pink leucophylla, but makes its best traps in spring! large $125

S. x areolata (Bone Daddy x MK L42) - Tall, Solid White, Pink Mouth - the best clone from a fun cross. 30-32” heavily alata-influenced traps are snow white with clean pencil veins in their upper portions and develop a contrasting pink mouth soon after opening. A lovely complex areolata. Medium $50

S. x “Camisole” - Medium height green and white traps with unaccountably large and floppy lids - absolutely charming. Large, $65, one plant available

S. x moorei “Artemis” (flava Killer x HCW Clone F) - Elegant, shapely, tall white-topped traps with an oversized blotch. Gorgeous clone. large $65

S. Royal Ruby - 36” deep maroon, shapely traps. Wild-collected in FL in the 90s and still one of the best red moorei around. A must for breeders.
- large $65

S. ( Vintner’s Treasure x oreophila) White Clone. Ghostly whitish topped traps develop beautiful purple veins and mouth over time. Vigorous, large plant that I have used in many crosses - large $60

S. Prince of Darkness - This clone is consistently the biggest, baddest, most imposing red in the collection. Reliably reaches 40” once vegetatively mature. - large $150

S. x moorei “Big Red” The name says it all: another stunning (LPL x fo) moorei from Phil. Large $60

S. x moorei “MPF-1” One of my favorite moorei! Red pitcher bodies with a beautifully contrasting creamy white lid, robust and stunning. Large $125

S. x moorei Leviathan - Exceptionally tall, easily over 40” each year. Green and white traps with venation in the throat - large $100

S. Crown of Thorns - A spectacular gem of a plant. Entirely white trap top / lid graced with a gaping mouth and chaotically kinked lip. Stunning and unique; one of my favorites each year - large $250, med $200

S. Chaos- Like a gigantic, macabre version of CoT - huge red traps with wild unruly lids and delightfully kinked lips. Really makes a terrific impression. Vigorous. - large $400

S. Tower of Terror - Large, tall fiery red and neon yellow traps with a killer energy to them. Quite unique and vibrant. SOLD OUT

S. x moorei (WRR x MK F27) Giant Pitchers. My own selection, consistently makes enormous, shapely solid red traps. An excellent red moorei -SOLD OUT

S. x moorei Blood Moon - huge, very dark, gargoyle traps. These have been doing amazingly for people and these select clones are some of my favorite plants. Mixed select clones from a large seedling batch. All very beautiful and dark - large $65

S. x moorei Vampire Queen, Escambia Co. AL - Beautiful leucophylla-esque pitchers with a violent, bloody blotch in the throat - stunning. Strong grower, best traps in fall. Large $150,
posts.body_text:
SPRING 2026 LIST UPDATE - LIMITED TIME SALE!
This is a
limited-time sale for Spring 2026
open from today, 3/20 through Friday 4/10
. This is my most extensive list ever, with many first-time releases. There just isn't room in the collection for average plants, and I stand behind every clone on this list being exceptional or noteworthy. I divided a TON of things this winter, so have at it!
Quantities are limited, so please email me at
calen.hall@gmail.com
for order confirmation before sending payment. Please
do not
order via Forum PM, Facebook Messenger, Instagram DM, etc. as I do not check those as often - thank you! Payment via PayPal to calen.hall@gmail.com only at this time. Please pay "Friends and Family" or include an additional 4% to cover PayPal's fee. Shipment bare-root via Priority Mail is typically $15-25, quoted order-by-order. I try not to charge too much for shipping.
USA only.
Do not hesitate to email me with any questions you may have!
Note: We are having an exceptionally early spring here in Oregon, and plants are waking up rapidly. I like to ship before plants have substantial fragile new growth that can be damaged in shipping, so I reserve the right to end the sale early and / or after a certain date ship only with the understanding that damage may occur.
Follow-up to the above: Due to record warmth and active growth I have shortened the sale window to end on 4/10 so I can complete packing and shipment no later than the weekend of Saturday 4/11.
Untitled
by
Calen Hall
, on Flickr
Size Guide
Small - should reach flowering size in the 2027 season and bloom in 2028
Medium - should reach flowering size during the 2026 season
Large - at least one flowering size growth point
XL - more than 4 flowering size growth points
Flavas
S. flava var. “specklecorpora” Best Clone, Miramar Beach, Walton Co. FL.
Extraordinary and unique genetics! Tubes are solid, bright red, but lid remains yellow and is covered in small to medium red dots. Developing traps resemble lit candles with their red bodies and bright yellow lids. Good vigor. One of the most spectacular flavas in the collection, exceedingly rare genetics. small $150
S. flava var. “specklecorpora” Clone 2, Miramar Beach, Walton Co. FL.
Not one but two dotticorporas on the list! Sibling to the above, and honestly is spottier! More dots on the upper tube and posterior column where Best Clone has more red infill. Amazing contrast, another standout each year. Can’t wait to see where folks can go breeding these genetics. large $250, medium $200
S. flava var. ornata Select Clone #1, Miramar Beach, Walton Co. FL.
One of the best location ornata in cultivation, period. From the now extinct MB ornata bog. Spectacular, intricate venation and a red mouth. It would be hard to choose just one ornata to grow, but this wouldn’t be a poor choice. Rarely available. Good vigor. large $100, med $75
S. flava var. cuprea North Carolina MK F90
- large, shapely traps with lovely burnt sugar tops. A solid and rarely offered Mike King selection. large $50
S. flava var. rubricorpora “Rare true red tube” Sandy Creek, Bay Co. FL
A lovely example of a rare true rubricorpora from the Sandy Creek bogs - solid red exterior, yellow and red lid (not an ornata that infuses). large $65
S. flava var atropurpurea Sandy Creek, Bay Co. FL
- Even rarer than the above! This clone reliably produces solid red, dark traps under natural light within a couple weeks of opening. A chance selection from a large seed grow-out and the only atro that I am aware of from these populations. large $85
S. flava var atropurpurea (Big Cuprea x Phil’s Blackwater Atro) Best Clone
- tall and solid red with big unruly lids. Selected from many, many seedlings. Vigorous and show-stopping. large $60
S. flava var. rubricorpora Solid Dark Red Traps 2015, Liberty Co. FL.
The darkest and most completely infused individual from a large seed grow out I did 10 years ago. First public release. It’s an atro but it comes from rubri genetics so that’s what I’m going with. Slighty shorter, to 24”, but overall vigor is good. large $70
S. flava var. ornata (Improved Black Veins x MK F88) Best Clone
- very large, incredibly ornately veined traps. Veins under the lid can become so dense it almost turns solid purple. Resembles a 30”+ Black Veins clone! large $75, med $50
S. flava var. rubricorpora Solid Red Throat, Liberty Co. FL
- a typical rubricorpora except that the mouth rapidly fills in with a pleasing bright red. Unusual and beautiful. large $45
S. flava “var. cuprea” (Bronze x cuprea) Select, J. Harris.
Outcross of Florida and Carolina coppertops with a fantastic result. Tall, shapely, very red/bronzy lids. Not quite an atro but much redder than standard cuprea. large $60 2 plants available
S. flava var atropurpurea (MK F27 x Powhatan) Darkest Clone.
This is a killer atro from my own breeding. Dark, big lids and doesn’t tend to brown out as the season progresses. Vigorous. Large $60
S. flava var. ornata (Killer x MK F88) Best Clone
- Hard to categorize this one! Large and brooding with a red mouth and various degrees of infusion elsewhere. Draws attention from visitors displaying the best of both parents. large $65
S. flava var. rubricorpora (Phil’s Red Tube x MK F149) Select Clone #2.
My own selection from the outstanding Liberty x Bay Co. rubri outcross done by Steve Galic. Tall, almost entirely red traps with just a touch of yellow in the lid. An outstanding red tube. large $75
S. flava var. ornata “Thick Traps” Santa Rosa Co. FL
Unique, boxy traps with a thick neck and wide lid. Reddish mouth and moderate venation. A weird western Florida flava! large $45
S. flava var atropurpurea Okaloosa Co. FL
- rare offering of selected, seed-grown reds that have been in the collection a long time. Very limited - these clones grow well but are slow dividers. large $125
S. flava var. “bronzy” Ultra Lid, Okaloosa Co. FL
. Atro-ornata intergrade with a ridiculous, ridiculous lid. Not difficult to imagine a rose parent a few generations back. Lovely example of how weird flava gets out in western FL. large $65, med $50
S. flava var. rubricorpora Liberty Co 2015
- mixed select dark clones. Divisions from my “keeper” clones, all lovely. large $50, med $35
S. flava var. ornata “Black Veins” Clone B, Bulloch Co. GA
. My favorite of the original BV clones that I grow. 12-14” traps are starkly pinstriped with an extremely wide mouth for the pitcher height. Narrow unblotched neck leads to a wide and intensely veined lid. A classic that you should grow if you don’t already! Moderate growth rate - not agonizing like some other original BV clones and will make a nice specimen over time. large $50
S. flava var. ornata “Extreme Black Veins” (Improved Black Veins x Black Veins Clone B)
- select clone from a large grow-out. Makes the incredible Clone B look unadorned by comparison. Very, very strong venation on shapely, dwarf traps. Makes my day every time I look at it during summer. large $90
S. flava var. ornata “Black Veins” Damon’s Clone , Bulloch Co. GA.
The strongest-growing original BV clone I know of. Lovely veins cover the wide-mouthed, short, blotched traps. Makes specimens readily. large $40
S. flava var. ornata Phil’s Clone
- parent of Saurus and many of Phil’s other incredible creations.  A mid-range ornata color-wise, but great structure and genetics - a must for breeders. 1 plant available, large $60
S. flava “Goldie”
- Unique and stunning, bright, true lemon yellow traps. Amazing for color potential in breeding. SOLD OUT
S. flava var. ornata “Outlaw” Bay Co FL
- From a relict, threatened population in western Bay Co. Semi-dwarf, shapely, pinstriped, red-lipped, blotched traps to 18”.  Still one of my favorite clones after many, many years. large $50, med $40
S. flava var. atropurpurea (cuprea BH x rubricorpora UCD) Ruffly Lid
- acquired this plant as a seedling from CCs in 2013 or so, and it’s still one of my favorite flavas. Large, solid red pitchers with a delightful wave to the lid margin. Divided up my big specimen mother plant after years of letting her grow out. large $50
S. flava var. rubricorpora Phil’s Clone, aka PRT
- the stud clone behind many of Phil’s famous crosses and a standout in its own right. Large-lidded traps to well over 30”, solid dark red except for a bit of yellow in the lid. A brooding shadow of a plant. Good vigor and a surprisingly good divider for a giant red tube. large $90, med $70
S. flava var. ornata Lidless, W. Buckner
- 6-8” dwarf, heavily veined traps. Solid growth rate and a good flower producer. Large $40
S. flava var. cuprea (Chocolate Top x MW Best) Red Mouth, Extra Dark
- Vigorous and shapely, looks like a mass of snakes when it’s pitchers open in spring. My selection from a Jerry A. cross. Strong copper lids deepening to chocolate, with a rare red mouth / lip. This plant turns solid red in bright greenhouse conditions. Large $45
S. flava var. cuprea (MW Best x Lois) “Atrocuprea”
- one of the brightest and reddest cupreas ever made, and can turn atro in optimal conditions. Very large, colorful, and vigorous.
Large $45
S. flava Big Mouth
- Karen Oudean selection, always gets a lot of attention! “What is THAT?” Etc. Huge yellow pitchers with a thick lip and veins in the mouth. - SOLD OUT
S. flava var. atropurpurea (cuprea Best Clone x Waccamaw) Best of Batch
- One of the best atropurpureas in the collection! Blood red with a gorgeous contrasting yellow mouth, gradually infusing fully. 30” pitchers. large $70
S. flava var. atropurpurea (cuprea Best Clone x Waccamaw) Clone #20
Virtually as good as Best of Batch in color, slightly smaller traps - large $45
S. flava var. atropurpurea Cooks Bayou Red, Bay Co. FL
- rare western Bay Co atro genetics. Solid red traps, but the real treat is the peachy-orange flowers that likely reflect introgression with rosea. large $45
S. flava var. Extreme Red Throat, Bay Co. FL
- Tall, strong growing clones with excellent blotches - mixed select clones - large $60
S. flava var. atropurpurea Waccamaw
- The real deal. I have big, big plants available here. XL $250
S. flava var. ornata Blackwater SF, Okaloosa Co. FL
- Very select ornata genetics, with some red lids / bronzy clones mixed in to boot. Mixed select clones - large $50
S. flava var. atropurpurea Blackwater SF “Phil’s Blackwater Atro” aka “PBA”
one of the best true atros in cultivation, colors easily and a beautiful shape - large $125
S. flava var. rubricorpora Wewahitchka MK F149
one of the darkest rubricorporas around, period. Strong grower too, great for breeding - SOLD OUT
S. flava var. ornata Apalachicola NF MK F88
- Robust red-mouthed traps with excellent venation. Great for breeding - one of my very favorite ornatas - large $60
S. flava var. atropurpurea “Hat Trick” (Big Cuprea x Phil’s Redtube)
- My own selection, first time public release. Tall, solid red pitchers with ridiculously large, flamboyant lids! Makes a statement. One of the coolest flavas in the entire collection.  medium $75
S. flava var. maxima Okaloosa Co. FL Select Clone #2
. Extremely rare genetics, choice seedling selected from many. Shapely, solid glowing green pitchers.- med $35
S. flava var. maxima Okaloosa Co. FL Most Vigorous Clone
. Extremely rare genetics, choice seedling selected from many. Shapely, solid glowing green pitchers.- large $50, med $35
S. flava var. rubricorpora “Burgundy” MK F26
. Adrian Slack’s ancestral red tube clone still holds it’s own. Shapely, solid red exterior, and a cute blotch - large $70, med $50
S. flava var. rugelii “Bud’s Gargoyle” Walton Co. FL
- Collected with permission on Bud Wilkerson’s hunting property. Ridiculously robust, huge mouth and lid. Truly a beast of a plant, hence the name. One of the best rugelii in cultivation - med-sm $75
S. flava var. rubricorpora Purple Tube, Milton FL MK F45
- a very nice, dark rubricorpora from the western range where the color form is uncommon - med-lg $50 1 plant available
S. flava var. atropurpurea (ornata Gulf Coast x cuprea Lois) Best Clone
- A stunner! 30-34” solid red pitchers, strong grower, one of my favorite flavas. large $100
S. flava var. cuprea Veinless, South Santee, SC
- incredible clone, reminds me of a chanterelle mushroom, one of my favorite flavas every year, shapely yellow overlain with inverse-veined orange-copper - large $100
Leucophyllas
S. leucophylla Yellow Flower, Citronelle, AL MK L69
- Cute green and white traps with typical leuco shape - not a lot of alata obvious in this one. large $40
S. leucophylla var. alba (MK L42 x HCW F) Rod’s Fave Sibling
- very white traps to over 30” when happy and also develops a pink mouth with age. large $75
S. leucophylla (Eastern AL x alba Solid White) Select Clone
- best seedling from a cross I did a while back. Not quite an alba, but an extremely white clone, particularly in the mouth. Vigorous and produces fall traps early and reliably. large $45
S. leucophylla “Puffy Cheeks” Baldwin Co. AL
- an outstanding “normal” leuco - reliably produces tall, big-mouthed pitchers with very pretty thin red veins. Makes a statement each fall. large $60
S. leucophylla “Super Pink” Baldwin Co. AL
- lovely pink selection from Mr. Wang. Produces large traps that infuse dark pink in the tube and mouth and stay whiter in the lid, creating a lovely contrast. large $75, 2 plants available
S. leucophylla var. alba “Vigorous Spring White” Washington Co. AL
- tall, very white traps, yellow flowers, good vigor. large $50
S. leucophylla “Big White” Okaloosa Co. FL
- One of my favorite plants! Not an alba but reliably makes a hedge of very white, stocky, voluminous, large-mouthed traps. Great for breeding and a particularly nice version of leuco for Okaloosa Co. large $80
S. leucophylla Tupelo Tree Bog, Baldwin Co. AL
- mixed select clones from a beautiful southern Baldwin Co. population. large $45
S. leucophylla Yellow Flower, Citronelle, AL MK L2
- Just a stunner! Unique shape with a flared mouth, skinny neck, and ostentatious lid. Vigorous and very reliable trap producer. Word to the wise: also seems to contain recessive alba genes and can breed really nice whites! Rare in the US.- large, $40
S. leucophylla Purple Lips x self, Clone 1
- One of the best leucos in cultivation. Better grower than PL. Must have for breeding. Very rare. - med $75
S. leucophylla “Bicolor” Yellow River, FL-
absolutely unique, highly sought-after clone. Pitchers rapidly develop a dark pink mouth and light pink tube. Stunning. - med-lg $150, medium $125
S. leucophylla Citronelle, AL MK L53
Underrated clone alert! Tall, alata-introgressed plant from the Citronelle areolata swarm. Amazing color quality - bright white + red suffusing to pink, interesting venation pattern. Excellent breeder. - large $50
S. leucophylla “Wilkerson’s Red Rocket” Walton Co. FL.
Another of the absolute best in cultivation. A must-have for serious growers! medium, small $60, medium $100
S. leucophylla “Aurora” Washington Co. AL (L53 x alba Solid White)
- gorgeous, delicately veined, shapely very white traps develop beautiful contrasting pink mouths - large $65
S. leucophylla “Red/Pink Mouth” Washington Co. AL (L53 x alba Solid White)
- sibling to Aurora with a bit larger traps and deeply contrasting pink mouth. Beautiful and unique. large $50
S. leucophylla Fuzzy Pink Spout Mouth Baldwin Co, AL
- Tall, slender tubes with an exaggerated, spouted lip, all infusing deep reddish pink inside and out. One of my favorite pinks. - medium $50,  lg $65
S. leucophylla Earliest Pitchering Clone, Baldwin Co. AL -
Pitchers in mid to late August for me and is always the first clone in the collection to make fall traps. A vigorous, “typical” leuco but excellent for breeding earlier-pitchering fall whites - large $40
S. leucophylla Pink PPP #5, Gorgeous Traps, Baldwin Co, AL
this one drops my jaw every season! Slender tubes with a spacious mouth open heavily veined then infuse deep pink. Consistent, early trap producer - medium $50, large $65
S. leucophylla Stocky, Early Pitchering Red & White, Bud Wilkerson Bog, Walton Co. FL
- very robust traps, and produces great pitchers early and reliably even in short season climates! Collected with permission from Bud’s pasture - large $50
S. leucophylla var. alba “Rod’s Favorite”
Tall, blinding traps. An outstanding alba year after year. Great breeder - medium $75, large $100
S. leucophylla var. alba (L53 x Solid White) Best Alba Clone
- tall, shapely, blinding white traps, vigorous. One of my best alba selections over the years, available again for the first time in a while! large $100
S. leucophylla Stocky Red & White, Bud Wilkerson Bog, Walton Co. FL
- a charming clone with good vigor that dependably puts up a nice hedge of colorful traps each fall. Collected with permission from Bud's Bog years ago. large $50
S. leucophylla Yellow River, Santa Rosa Co FL. MK L33
- a very interesting clone with white that stretches abnormally far down the tube. From the now largely destroyed Yellow River site, I suspect some distant rubra gulfensis introgression here. Unique and one of my favorites. Great breeding potential. large $50
Alatas
S. alata “Super Alata”
- Jerry Addington selection, possibly the largest dark alata in cultivation HUGE, very dark pitchers. Quite shocking how big this guy can get. Very rare. large $150, med, $125
S. alata Red Cobra
- Another ridiculous Jerry alata! 30” + bulbous, hooded traps, just incredible. Unique brighter red trap color, as opposed to “black”. Undoubtedly one of the best alata in cultivation - large $175, med $150
S. alata “Black Throat”
- A beautiful, shapely, very dark alit I acquired from Phil years ago. This is one parent of Black Widow, if memory serves. large $50
S. alata (“Night” x self)
A great example of how selfing good clones can create even better clones. Larger and darker than Night, very robust and vigorous, reliably producing large traps in late summer and fall. large $60
Hybrids
S. Legacy
- Well-deserving of its reputation - large white traps spring and fall, incredible presence - large $250
S. x moorei “Elvis Wilkerson” Walton Co. FL
-  Very large growing complex moorei from Leah’s front yard. Large $125
S. x areolata Whitest Clone, Jackson Co. MS
selected from a large seedling batch, this clone looks just like a robust, bulbous alata shape-wise but with a white-infused upper tube and lid, and a few veins in the mouth. Super cool, introgressed clone, great for areolata breeding projects and should bring good white genes to the table in general! - large $65
S. ‘Black Widow’
Vigorous, huge, dark traps, a favorite of mine year after year - large $50
S. x moorei ‘Catrin Claire’
- Electric candy apple red mouth beneath a large, frilly red and white lid. Stunning clone, great breeder. large 1 GP $300, large 2 GPs $400
S. x moorei ‘Saxapahaw’
-  large, exceptionally shapely red traps. Gorgeous and rarely offered.- large $150
S. ‘The Kraken’
large $200, med $125
S. x moorei Wilkerson’s White Knight, Walton Co. FL
- Beautiful, large white topped traps with an incredible blotch - XL $250, med large $100
S. x moorei (leuco alba Solid White x ornata Improved Black Veins) Best Clone
- medium height with very dark inky veins and a contrasting creamy top. Vigorous. large $45
S. x moorei (flava Killer x Super Leuco #1)
- Very tall, shapely red traps. Large $45, med $30
S. (Reptilian Rose x Leah Wilkerson) Tall & Crazy
- 36” red traps with a weird, distorted mouth and whitish lid. Some might think this plant is ugly, but I’ve certainly kept it around! Large $50
S. (Reptilian Rose x Legacy) Select Clone
- bright pinkish red coloration with a throat blotch underneath. Nicely Spouted mouth and a large, attractive peaked lid - large $50
S. (Reptilian Rose x Caitrin Claire) Select Clone
- large pink traps with big, unruly lids! large $60, med $45
S. (Vintner’s Treasure x oreophila) x leuco alba Rod’s Favorite - Select Contrast
- One of my best selections from the last several years. Attractive traps to 36”, hot pink to purple trap bodies and a pure white lid with stark purple veins. Reliably makes both strong spring and fall traps outdoors in Oregon! large $150
S. (Vintner’s Treasure x oreophila) x leuco alba Rod’s Favorite - Best Clone, Solid White.
My goal with this cross was to create plants that make strong white traps in spring, and this clone delivers. Tall, shapely, solid white spring traps outdoors in Cold Oregon. A “leuco alba” you can enjoy in the early season! SOLD OUT
S. x moorei (Prince of Darkness x Super Leuco #1) - Mega Dark & Tall
. Enormous and very dark traps - this one pushed 40” last season for me. SOLD OUT
S. (Crown of Thorns x Caitrin Claire) “Lady Rose”
- Best seedling from the cross, absolutely best of both parents. Tall white traps, yawning pink mouth and white lid shot through with purple veins. The color quality is unreal on this one. SOLD OUT
S. (Crown of Thorns x Caitrin Claire) - “Rose Witch”
- this clone is all of CC’s colors mapped onto CoT's shape - stunning. Candy apple red, scalloped and toothy mouth, red and white lid + tube. SOLID OUT
S. (Leah Wilkerson x Caitrin Claire) Best Clone
- Robust traps to over 30”, ghostly white upper tube and lid with a beautiful, faded watercolor-like throat blotch. Large $150, one plant available
S. x moorei ‘Vicious Valentine’
- big, delicately veined shapely traps with creamy, peaked, oversize lids and an unruly red-lipped mouth. A lovely selection - large $125
S. x moorei ‘Vintner’s Treasure’
- One of Phil’s crown jewels, and one of the best red moorei ever made. Exceptionally large, red-purple, beautifully shaped traps. Rarely offered. Large, 3 growth points $500, large, 1 growth point $300.
S. (Reptilian Rose x Adrian Slack) “The Beast”
- 4” wide rippled red mouths under an orangey, veined lid. Produces shockingly large, volcanic traps. Likely the most robust and imposing Sarracenia I have personally bred. med-large $300, med $250
S. (Reptilian Rose x Adrian Slack) - Kinky Pink Lip, White Lid
- sibling to the above. Vigorous clone producing hedges of 30-33” traps - med $75, large $100
S. (leuco alba Solid White x Grendel) Best Clone
- Tall, open-mouthed white-topped traps. Vigorous and makes excellent pitchers in both spring and fall. Large $50
S. x catesbaei “Bengal Tiger”
- it’s been too long since I’ve offered this beautiful cat! Intensely veined, blotched traps to around 12” with wide cobra-esque lids. If you only grew one catesbaei, this would be an excellent choice. medium $30, large $45
S. ‘Elaine’s Ice & Fire’
- One of Jerry A’s best creations. Dark purple red tubes with a stunningly contrasting white lid. Traps to around 22-24” - exceedingly rare. Large $500, 2 plants available.
S. ‘Ellie Wang’
- A standout from the legendary Mike W - shapely traps to 24” exhibit solid dark pink-red bodies and contrasting white lids. Lovely and rare. medium $200, large $300
S. x ‘Emma’
- one of THE most beautiful and unique Sarracenias ever created - great work Danny P! 30” traps with manta ray-like red, pink and white, veined lids. The color quality and contrast is unmatched. One of my favorite plants. Best traps in fall. SOLD OUT
S. x mitchelliana “D-P”
- Likely the best mitch ever made (a Phil creation, of course!). Parent of Mega Mouth, D-P produces wide, beefy, cartoonishly robust pink and white traps to about 18” - SOLD OUT
S. “Mitch’s Sexy Leg”
Parentage is (mitchelliana D-P x Saxapahaw) x Legacy - I got tired of saying that, hence the clone name
. Deep red-pink trap bodies under wide, wavy, red / white / pink lids that hold their contrast beautifully. Traps to 30”, best in fall. Fantastic breeder. large $200
S. (Vintner’s Treasure x oreophila) x leuco Big White, Okaloosa Co. FL - Best Clone
- another awesome selection from my spring white breeding efforts. Looks for all the world like a robust pink leucophylla, but makes its best traps in spring! large $125
S. x areolata (Bone Daddy x MK L42) - Tall, Solid White, Pink Mouth
- the best clone from a fun cross. 30-32” heavily alata-influenced traps are snow white with clean pencil veins in their upper portions and develop a contrasting pink mouth soon after opening. A lovely complex areolata. Medium $50
S. x “Camisole”
- Medium height green and white traps with unaccountably large and floppy lids - absolutely charming. Large, $65, one plant available
S. x moorei “Artemis” (flava Killer x HCW Clone F)
- Elegant, shapely, tall white-topped traps with an oversized blotch. Gorgeous clone. large $65
S. Royal Ruby
- 36” deep maroon, shapely traps. Wild-collected in FL in the 90s and still one of the best red moorei around. A must for breeders.
- large $65
S. ( Vintner’s Treasure x oreophila) White Clone.
Ghostly whitish topped traps develop beautiful purple veins and mouth over time. Vigorous, large plant that I have used in many crosses - large $60
S. Prince of Darkness
- This clone is consistently the biggest, baddest, most imposing red in the collection. Reliably reaches 40” once vegetatively mature. - large $150
S. x moorei “Big Red”
The name says it all: another stunning (LPL x fo) moorei from Phil. Large $60
S. x moorei “MPF-1”
One of my favorite moorei! Red pitcher bodies with a beautifully contrasting creamy white lid, robust and stunning. Large $125
S. x moorei Leviathan
- Exceptionally tall, easily over 40” each year. Green and white traps with venation in the throat - large $100
S. Crown of Thorns
- A spectacular gem of a plant. Entirely white trap top / lid graced with a gaping mouth and chaotically kinked lip. Stunning and unique; one of my favorites each year - large $250, med $200
S. Chaos
- Like a gigantic, macabre version of CoT - huge red traps with wild unruly lids and delightfully kinked lips. Really makes a terrific impression. Vigorous. - large $400
S. Tower of Terror
- Large, tall fiery red and neon yellow traps with a killer energy to them. Quite unique and vibrant. SOLD OUT
S. x moorei (WRR x MK F27) Giant Pitchers
. My own selection, consistently makes enormous, shapely solid red traps. An excellent red moorei -SOLD OUT
S. x moorei Blood Moon
- huge, very dark, gargoyle traps. These have been doing amazingly for people and these select clones are some of my favorite plants. Mixed select clones from a large seedling batch. All very beautiful and dark - large $65
S. x moorei Vampire Queen, Escambia Co. AL
- Beautiful leucophylla-esque pitchers with a violent, bloody blotch in the throat - stunning. Strong grower, best traps in fall.  Large $150,

posts.body_html:
So my order from Calen came in a few days ago.. I've been stupidly busy at work and getting home late so I haven't had time to take pictures during the day... until today! Exceptionally well grown plants, great packaging, incredibly nice through e-mail for ordering.. highly recommend Calen and his plants! Here are the amazing plants that came in!

S. leucophylla 'Red' - with something like 5, possibly 6 growing points - crazy large division!


Finally decided to jump and buy a.. S. 'Reptilian Rose'! It actually had 3 growing points on it, which I was amazed at for the price, I know someone personally that paid just a little less for their division but it only had one growing point!


I've wanted to increase my collection of alatas, since I have a ton of flavas and a few leucos so I decided to jump for a division of Calens S. alata 'Night'. Definitely not disappointed.


Onto the smaller plants! Keeping with the 'I really want to find more nice alatas'... I ordered one of his alata 'Black Throat' x self seedlings.. Awesome coloring for a young plant!


I purchased a division of a HCW during the winter last year and it was a decent size, but I really wanted one of the ones that has a really 'eye-popping' white.. So I decided to try one of Calens alba HCW Clone A x Clone F.


He also threw in two freebies with the order that are great looking! I wanted to expand my purpurea collection since the purpurea ssp. purpurea I have grew so well - picture in my main collection thread, and a venosa that's still pretty small. Here is a S. purpurea montana x venosa


And lastly here we have another freebie! S. flava var. Ornata Gulf Co. x LW5 - you can really see that Leah red throat showing through!


Anyone that hasn't worked with Calen yet is missing out on some amazing plants!
